title: Offset Face -0.25 mm on the Geocache's modeled M33x3.5 thread

expect.note: book parity report, Project 7. Every face of the thread (flanks, roots, the crest) moved 0.25 mm into the material, the Thread step's FaceOffset. Hand check: the thread's faces are 2488.5 mm2, so the layer is about 2488.5 * 0.25 = 622 mm3 to first order; the model loses 614.9 (the layer thins where it turns the outside corners at the crest). The number is FreeCAD's
